exposure: Maternal depressive symptoms in early pregnancy
Maternal anxiety symptoms in early pregnancy
cohort: A birth cohort of 5263 children whose mothers were assessed for depressive and anxiety symptoms in early pregnancy.
finding: Maternal depressive and anxiety symptoms, both individually and comorbidly, in early pregnancy were associated with an increased risk of atopic dermatitis and allergic rhinitis in offspring during toddlerhood, with a greater risk of asthma found for boys born to mothers with mild anxiety.
